threads.body: The new javaagent configuration parser has no direct tests. The updated javaagent test JVM arguments cover only a non-empty `included` selector, so `excluded`-only configuration, replacement-vs-deprecated precedence, v3 suppression, and the one-time deprecation warning can regress independently of the separately tested Spring implementation. Please add focused `LogbackConfig` tests, analogous to `GrpcConfigTest`, for these branches.

replies.body:
Addressed in 0f139d9d5193ec9ee55ef26cb456772872907f7d.

Analysis: Javaagent implementation classes are hidden from agent-backed tests by class loader separation, so add the repository-standard javaagent-unit-tests module and exercise LogbackConfig directly there. The tests cover excluded-only selection, new-selector precedence, v3 suppression of the deprecated property, and include-only fallback with a single warning.

Upsides: Protects all requested parser branches independently of Spring behavior and integration-test JVM arguments.

Downsides: Adds a small Gradle submodule and test-only reflection to reset the private one-time warning flag.

replies.body:
Good call — added `mdcAttributesIncluded` and `mdcAttributesExcluded` so the selector is configurable from `logback.xml`:

```xml
<appender name="OpenTelemetry" class="io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.logback.appender.v1_0.OpenTelemetryAppender">
  <mdcAttributesIncluded>request-*,user-?</mdcAttributesIncluded>
  <mdcAttributesExcluded>*-secret</mdcAttributesExcluded>
</appender>
```

`setMdcAttributes(IncludeExclude)` still wins over the XML elements, which win over the deprecated `captureMdcAttributes` (which now keeps its exact historical literal-key semantics, including the sole-`*` special case).

+### 📈 Enhancements
+
+- Add `otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.mdc-attributes.included` and
+  `otel.instrumentation.logback-appender.experimental.mdc-attributes.excluded`, which select the MDC
+  keys captured as log attributes using case-sensitive glob patterns where `?` matches one character
+  and `*` matches any number of characters. Excluded patterns take precedence over included
+  patterns, and configuring only excluded patterns captures every MDC attribute that they do not
+  exclude. The same selector is available in `logback.xml` as `mdcAttributesIncluded` and
+  `mdcAttributesExcluded`.
+  ([#19520](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/19520))
